v1.name: createPath
v1.description: Create a closed editable path. points is a flat array of [x,y,inX,inY,outX,outY] per vertex. All six coordinates are ABSOLUTE layer-local pixels, origin at the layer center, NOT handle offsets or composition coordinates. For straight edges repeat the vertex three times: [x,y,x,y,x,y]; zero handles curve toward the origin. Typically vertices span -width/2..width/2 and -height/2..height/2. position places the local origin in the composition.
